_meta.notes: idx 12 is always slide number. Footer placeholders at y~5.19 are tiny (1.7x0.17) — do NOT use for visible content.

content_diagram_text.description: Diagram + two text sections with split ratios. Generates 3 variants at different ratios.
content_diagram_text.use_for: Architecture diagrams with explanatory text, any visual + two-section commentary

title_cover.description: Title/cover slide — full-bleed background image + manual text overlay
title_cover.use_for: Opening slide of any deck. Supports single-line (38pt) or two-line split (56pt) with auto-detection.

rules: If headline contains an em dash, split there and DROP the dash
Max two lines for title text — never three
If the pre-dash part is short (< 20 chars), use two-line at 56pt
If no natural break or title is short enough, use single-line at 38pt
Line 1 is always white, line 2 is always pink (#FF33BB)

chapter_divider.description: Chapter divider — large headline centered over background image
chapter_divider.use_for: Major section breaks (Agenda, Overview, Appendix, etc.)

chapter_divider_clean.description: Chapter divider — large headline, no background image
chapter_divider_clean.use_for: Section breaks without images, cleaner look

headline.role: Large centered headline (wider than image variant)

agenda.description: Numbered agenda — fully manual rendering on clean canvas. Left image + right numbered items with divider lines.

big_stat.description: Large stat/number with description label above
big_stat.use_for: Hero numbers, key metrics, impact stats

number.role: Large number or stat — use huge font

content_image_text.description: Left text + right image — headline, subheadline, body on left; image on right
content_image_text.use_for: Architecture diagrams, screenshots with explanation, visual + text combos

content_two_col.description: Headline + two titled columns (compact headline, content lower)

variant_text_heavy.note: Same structure but smaller headline (0.51h), columns start at y=1.39 with 2.94h bodies — use for text-heavy content

content_three_col.use_for: Three-topic overviews, three pillars, three phases

variant_text_heavy.note: Same structure with smaller headline, taller body areas

content_four_cards.description: Headline + four card columns (title + body each)

content_h3_two_col.description: H3 headline + two wider titled columns (more generous spacing)

variant_text_heavy.note: Same structure, taller body areas (2.15h vs 1.03h)

content_h3_three_col.description: H3 headline + three titled columns (wider spacing)

content_generic.description: Generic slide — headline only, add content via manual text boxes

manual_content_area.note: Add text boxes and images in the area below the headline

thank_you.description: Closing/thank you slide — reuses chapter divider layout
